name: Pi-hole
author: Netlens
description: Registers your devices in Pi-hole's Local DNS (Pi-hole v6): an A record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Pi-hole makes the reverse (PTR) answer by itself. Netlens only changes records it wrote itself (it remembers them, Pi-hole has no comment field) and never touches records you or anything else made.

config.label: Pi-hole servers
config.help: Every Pi-hole that should carry the records (with two Pi-holes kept in sync by Gravity Sync or Orbital Sync, list only the one you write to). Use an app password (Settings → Web interface / API → Configure app password) instead of the admin password.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Only relevant for https addresses. Turn it off for the self-signed certificate Pi-hole makes itself.
